messages:
maria-cs: Quick kickoff — Everest private deployment readiness check. Infra window starts tomorrow 09:00 PT. Wanted a short sync on network / IAM / KMS / audit log handoff. Please reply with verification or blockers.

alex-net: I can confirm the customer CIDR and peering plan. Need final firewall rules and proxy IPs from their infra team.

sara-impl: Running the final change with infra tomorrow morning. Firewall rules are 10.23.0.0/16 -> allow ports 443, 22, 1194 (VPN). Will share NAT IPs in 30m.

lee-ops: For the private runtime we need the IAM role ARN and the STS trust policy. If they want CTK-based temporary creds we need to enable STS in the account.

nathan-sec: KMS: customer wants to bring their own key (BYOK). We need the exact KMS key ARN and key policy that allows Redwood Principal to decrypt/encrypt and create grants. Also want to confirm CloudTrail->S3 audit bucket + CloudWatch logs retention.

sara-impl: KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. Key policy will be provided in the ticket. Audit bucket is s3://everest-redwood-audit, retention 90 days.

alex-net: Confirmed CIDR and NAT. Firewall egress for health checks to 52.23.12.0/24 and 13.52.0.0/16 (these are third-party endpoints) — I'll add that in the ruleset.

lee-ops: IAM role provided: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPrivateRuntimeRole. Need the minimal policy we expect — will paste below for their team to attach.

lee-ops: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject","kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

nathan-sec: Minor request: enable CloudTrail multi-region and send logs to the S3 bucket with SSE-KMS using the provided key. Also add lifecycle policy to move to Glacier after 30 days.

sara-impl: We can do that. I'll schedule the lifecycle and send an updated policy doc in the ticket.

maria-cs: Good — two operational items: (1) Enablement session for app owners & SRE at Tuesday 10:00 PT (invite sent). (2) Can someone confirm if there are any renewal/account risks we should flag to AM?

lee-ops: Risk note: If the customer declines to give Redwood grant permission on the KMS key (they prefer manual grants), that increases ops overhead and could delay cutover by 24-48h. Recommend AM aware.

nathan-sec: Also flag: no CloudTrail encryption or missing lifecycle would be a compliance risk. Recommend we mark as "conditional compliance" until logs and key grants confirmed.

maria-cs: Noted. I'll mark renewal risk as "watch" and escalate to AM with the conditional items.

deploy-bot: preflight-checklist: network:true, iam:false, kms:partial, audit-logs:false, tls-certs:true. See /preflight/1769998421.

alex-net: I'll finish firewall and post the final rules in the ticket in 20m.

sara-impl: Sharing the NAT IPs and updated key policy now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
